title: requests default: newest first, 20 rows
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['filter']; assert f['sort']=='newest', f; assert f['per']=='20'; assert len(d['rows'])<=20; assert d['total']>0"

title: requests page count matches the total
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json,math; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['filter']; assert f['pages']==max(1,math.ceil(f['total']/20)), (f['pages'],f['total'])"

title: requests pages do not overlap or drop rows
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=3&page=1' > /tmp/lg1.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=3&page=2' > /tmp/lg2.json; python3 -c "import json; a=[r['id'] for r in json.load(open('/tmp/lg1.json'))['rows']]; b=[r['id'] for r in json.load(open('/tmp/lg2.json'))['rows']]; assert not (set(a)&set(b)); assert min(a)>max(b)"

title: requests sort=oldest flips the order
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=3&sort=oldest' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ids=[r['id'] for r in d['rows']]; assert ids==sorted(ids), ids; assert d['filter']['sort']=='oldest'"

title: requests sort=cost is monotonic descending
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5&sort=cost' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=[r['cost'] for r in d['rows']]; assert c==sorted(c, reverse=True), c; assert d['filter']['sort']=='cost'"

title: requests sort=tokens is monotonic descending
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5&sort=tokens' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); t=[(r['prompt_tokens'] or 0)+(r['completion_tokens'] or 0) for r in d['rows']]; assert t==sorted(t, reverse=True), t"

title: requests sort=latency is monotonic descending
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5&sort=latency' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); l=[r['latency_ms'] or 0 for r in d['rows']]; assert l==sorted(l, reverse=True), l"

title: a sort key that is SQL is rejected, and the table survives
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=2&sort=id%20DESC%3B%20DROP%20TABLE%20requests' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['filter']['sort']=='newest', d['filter']['sort']"; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=1' | python3 -c "import sys,json; assert json.load(sys.stdin)['total']>0"

title: page past the end clamps to the last page
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5&page=99999' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['filter']; assert f['page']==f['pages'], f; assert len(d['rows'])>0"

title: per=0 clamps to 1 rather than dividing by zero
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=0' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['filter']; assert f['per']=='1', f; assert len(d['rows'])==1"

title: an absurd per is capped
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=100000' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert int(d['filter']['per'])<=500, d['filter']['per']; assert len(d['rows'])<=500"

title: profile filter narrows and echoes back
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests' > /tmp/lga.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?profile=l2' > /tmp/lgb.json; python3 -c "import json; a=json.load(open('/tmp/lga.json')); b=json.load(open('/tmp/lgb.json')); assert b['total']<a['total'], (b['total'],a['total']); assert b['filter']['profile']=='l2'; assert all(r['profile']=='l2' for r in b['rows'])"

title: an unknown profile returns zero, not an error
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?profile=definitely-not-a-profile' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['total']==0; assert d['rows']==[]"

title: per=all returns every row on one page
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=all' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d['rows'])==d['total']; assert d['filter']['pages']==1"

title: two identical requests return identical bytes
cmd: a=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5' | md5sum); b=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/requests?per=5' | md5sum); [ "$a" = "$b" ]

title: decisions default: newest first
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=2' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ids=[r['id'] for r in d['rows']]; assert ids==sorted(ids, reverse=True), ids; assert d['total']>0"

title: decisions sort=oldest flips the order
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=3&sort=oldest' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ids=[r['id'] for r in d['rows']]; assert ids==sorted(ids), ids"

title: decisions page count matches the total
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json,math; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['filter']; assert f['pages']==max(1,math.ceil(f['total']/20)), (f['pages'],f['total'])"

title: decisions per=all returns every row
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=all' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d['rows'])==d['total']"

title: every decision row carries the routing verdict
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=25' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); miss=[r['id'] for r in d['rows'] if not (r.get('profile') and r.get('provider') and r.get('model') and r.get('action'))]; assert not miss, miss"

title: decisions are idempotent
cmd: a=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=5' | md5sum); b=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=5' | md5sum); [ "$a" = "$b" ]

title: /api/logs reports total, rows and facets
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/logs' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['total']>0; assert d['rows']; assert {'total','limit','offset','rows','profiles','providers'} <= set(d)"

title: /api/logs honours its limit
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/logs?limit=5' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d['rows'])<=5, len(d['rows'])"

title: the logs tab ships the shared table module
cmd: out=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/activity?tab=logs'); echo "$out" | grep -q 'logtable.js' && echo "$out" | grep -q 'lg-rows' && echo "$out" | grep -q 'lg-controls'

title: every log table carries a non-empty caption
cmd: for t in logs 'logs&view=providers'; do curl -s "{{BASE}}/activity?tab=$t" | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); caps=re.findall(r'<caption[^>]*>(.*?)</caption>', h, re.S); assert len(caps)==1, (len(caps), caps); assert caps[0].strip(), 'empty caption'" || exit 1; done

title: every log header carries scope=col
cmd: for t in logs 'logs&view=providers'; do curl -s "{{BASE}}/activity?tab=$t" | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); ths=re.findall(r'<th[\s>](?![^>]*scope)', h); assert not ths, len(ths)" || exit 1; done
